answer_4.quote: Three computer science undergraduates familiar with Linux annotate conversations by (1) identifying turn intervals which exhibit friction along with explanations and (2) judging the success of overall conversation on a three-point scale.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were instructed to identify turn intervals exhibiting conversational friction and provide explanations, and to judge conversation success on a three-point scale (1: No Progress, 2: Some Progress, 3: Success). Instructions were kept identical to Prompt A.1, which defines friction and success criteria.
